Messages.Author: GuyRusso6
Messages.Body:
16 players gathered at Maplewood Hobbies in NJ on August 27th. When the smoke cleared John B. Whelan was victorious with his Enkidu deck. The tournament was standard construction with 2R + F. The final seating was Enkidu >> Presence Votes >> Inside Dirt >> Potence Rush >> Tremere Shenanigans

Here is the tournament winning deck:

Enkidu's August Rising

Crypt (12)
5x Enkidu, the Noah
2x Jeremy "Wix" Wyzchovsky
2x Anarch Convert
1x Cesar Holfield
1x Iris Bennett
1x Walter Grimes

Library (90)

Masters (8)
1x Perfectionist
1x Millicent Smith
1x Antediluvian Awakening
1x Archon Investigation
1x Society of Leopold
3x Vessel

Actions (11)
1x Taunt the Caged Beast
1x Ambush
1x Sense Death
1x Deep Song
4x Raven Spy
1x Mr. Winthrop
1x Jackie Therman
1x Murder of Crows

Action Modifiers (15)
1x Zephyr
3x Freak Drive
1x Forced March
1x Mask of 1000 Faces
3x Instantaneous Transformation
3x Swallowed by the Night **
3x Shadow Boxing **
** these double as combat cards

Combat (48, or 54 counting ** cards, above)
11x Immortal Grapple
9x Taste of Vitae
7x Bear's Skin
6x Claws of the Dead
7x Pursuit
3x Skin of Steel
2x Elemental Stoicism
1x Leathery Hide
1x Roundhouse
1x Shadow Feint

Reaction (8)
8x Sense the Savage Way

Abashed the devil stood and felt how awful goodness is ~Milton~
